contentHtml:
10 inch round cake invites a cozy kitchen moment, with golden sponge layers rising soft and cloudlike and the gentle warmth of vanilla in every crumb. A silky buttercream gets whipped to perfection, brightened with a splash of lemon juice for sunny balance. Frost the 10 inch round cake with playful swirls, then crown it with vibrant berries that sparkle like little gems. Perfect for birthdays, tea parties, or any sweet occasion, this 10 inch round cake is simple to assemble, joyful to share, and guaranteed to bring smiles to the table.

Why You’ll Love This 10 inch round cake

  • Perfect for any celebration, big or small.
  • Moist and fluffy texture that melts in your mouth.
  • Endless flavor combinations to suit every palate.
  • Impressive presentation that wows your guests.
  • Easy to customize with your favorite toppings.

10 inch round cake

Discover the secrets to creating an exclusive 10 inch round cake that will wow your guests! 🎂 Perfect for any celebration!✨

Ingredients Equipment Method Notes

Ingredients
  

Dry Ingredients
  • 2¾ cups all-purpose flour for the cake’s structure
  • 2½ tsp baking powder provides leavening
  • ½ tsp salt enhances flavor
Wet Ingredients
  • 2 cups granulated sugar adds sweetness and moisture
  • 1 cup unsalted butter at room temperature for creaminess
  • 4 large eggs binds the ingredients together
  • 1 cup whole milk keeps the cake moist
  • 2 tsp vanilla extract adds a lovely aroma

Equipment

  • 1 10-inch round cake pan Greased and floured for easy removal
  • 1 Mixing bowl For mixing ingredients
  • 1 whisk For mixing dry ingredients
  • 1 Spatula For smoothing the batter
  • 1 Oven Preheated to 350°F (175°C)

Method
 

Preparation
  1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour a 10-inch round cake pan to ensure your cake comes out easily.
Mix Dry Ingredients
  1. In a bowl, whisk together 2¾ cups of flour, 2½ tsp of baking powder, and ½ tsp of salt. This will be the base of your cake.
Cream Butter and Sugar
  1. In a separate bowl, cream together 1 cup of softened butter and 2 cups of sugar until the mixture is light and fluffy.
Add Eggs and Vanilla
  1. Add 4 eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Stir in 2 tsp of vanilla extract.
Combine Ingredients
  1. Alternately add the dry ingredients and 1 cup of milk to the butter mixture, starting and ending with the dry ingredients. Mix until just combined.
Pour the Batter
  1. Pour the batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top with a spatula.
Bake the Cake
  1. Bake in the preheated oven for 30–35 minutes. Check if it’s done by inserting a toothpick in the center; it should come out clean.
Cool the Cake
  1. Let the cake cool in the pan for 10 minutes. Then, remove it to a wire rack to cool completely.

How to Make 10 inch round cake

This delightful 10 inch round cake is perfect for any occasion! With a preparation time of about 15 minutes, a cooking time of 30–35 minutes, and a cooling time of 10 minutes, you’ll have a delicious cake ready to impress your friends and family!

Step 1: Preheat the Oven

Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour a 10-inch round cake pan to ensure your cake comes out easily.

Step 2: Mix Dry Ingredients

In a bowl, whisk together 2 cups of flour, 2 teaspoons of baking powder, and 1/2 teaspoon of salt. This will be the base of your cake.

Step 3: Cream Butter and Sugar

In a separate bowl, cream together 1/2 cup of softened butter and 1 cup of sugar until the mixture is light and fluffy. This step adds air to your cake!

Step 4: Add Eggs and Vanilla

Add 3 eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Stir in 1 teaspoon of vanilla extract for that lovely flavor.

Step 5: Combine Ingredients

Alternately add the dry ingredients and 1 cup of milk to the butter mixture, starting and ending with the dry ingredients. Mix until just combined; don’t overmix!

Step 6: Pour the Batter

Pour the batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top with a spatula. It’s looking good already!

Step 7: Bake the Cake

Bake in the preheated oven for 30–35 minutes. Check if it’s done by inserting a toothpick in the center; it should come out clean.

Step 8: Cool the Cake

Let the cake cool in the pan for 10 minutes. Then, remove it to a wire rack to cool completely. Patience is key!

Recipe Snapshot

Pro Tips for Making 10 inch round cake

  • Use room temperature ingredients for a smoother batter.
  • Grease and flour your pan to prevent sticking.
  • Check for doneness with a toothpick; it should come out clean.
  • Let the cake cool completely before frosting for best results.
  • Experiment with flavors by adding extracts or spices to the batter.

How to Serve this 10 inch round cake

  • Serve with a scoop of vanilla ice cream for a delightful contrast.
  • Pair with fresh berries for a burst of flavor and color.
  • Top with whipped cream and a sprinkle of chocolate shavings.
  • Drizzle with a homemade fruit sauce for an extra touch.
  • Enjoy with a cup of herbal tea for a cozy afternoon treat.
  • Slice and serve with a dollop of yogurt for a lighter option.

Make Ahead and Storage

You can make this cake ahead and store it easily:

Storing Leftovers

  • Allow the cake to cool completely.
  • Wrap it tightly in plastic wrap.
  • Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 3 days.
  • For longer storage, refrigerate for up to a week.

Freezing

  • Wrap the cooled cake in plastic wrap, then aluminum foil.
  • Label with the date and type of cake.
  • Freeze for up to 3 months for best quality.
  • Thaw in the refrigerator overnight before serving.

Reheating

  • Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
  • Place the cake on a baking sheet.
  • Cover loosely with foil to prevent drying.
  • Heat for about 10-15 minutes until warmed through.

FAQs

Here’s a helpful FAQ about this recipe:

1. What size cake pans do I need for a 10 inch round cake?

To make a 10 inch round cake, you will need two 10 inch round cake pans. This will allow you to create a layered cake, which is perfect for celebrations! Make sure to grease and flour the pans to prevent sticking.

2. How long do I bake a 10 inch round cake?

Typically, a 10 inch round cake will bake for about 30 to 40 minutes at 350°F (175°C). However, it’s always best to check for doneness by inserting a toothpick in the center; if it comes out clean, your cake is ready!

3. How many people does a 10 inch round cake serve?

A 10 inch round cake typically serves 12 to 16 people, depending on how you slice it. If you cut larger party-style slices, you’ll get about 12 servings. For smaller wedding or event portions, you can easily serve up to 16 guests.

4. Can I use this recipe for different cake pan sizes?

Yes! You can adapt this recipe for other pan sizes. For example, divide the batter into two 8 inch pans for a taller layered cake, or bake it in a 9×13 inch rectangular pan for a sheet-style cake. Just be sure to adjust the baking time — smaller pans may need 5–10 minutes less, while larger ones may need slightly more.

Final Thoughts

As you dive into making this delightful 10 inch round cake, remember the joy it brings to gatherings and celebrations! It’s simple, rewarding, and oh-so-delicious. So, gather your loved ones, whip up this cake, and savor every bite together. Happy baking, and may your kitchen be filled with laughter and sweet memories!
